title: Wendell and the Harvest
author: Beatrix Montrose
blurb: Odile Lockridge, a hospice nurse who hears the dying count backwards, has spent fifteen years telling themselves the noises have explanations. But when the village's church bell rings although the bell was melted down in 1911, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must get the family out ahead of the count before the well refills.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
